items.question: In what vast array of womb-diagrams are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
The loci are described as womb-diagrams.
Beings within these loci are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense multiplicity of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is not explicitly named in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
